Uses only outcomes visible before the operational boundary.

estimand_or_formula: Within bin B: mean_i[ R_i Y_i / e_i ], e_i=P(R_i=1 | X_i), with lower-tail clipping.
conditioning_or_assumption: Requires conditional exchangeability of Y and R given nuisance features X, correct/adequate observation model for pure IPW, and positivity e_i>0 on target support.

estimand_or_formula: Within bin B: sum_i R_i Y_i/e_i divided by sum_i R_i/e_i.
conditioning_or_assumption: Same observation-model and positivity conditions as binary IPW; normalization changes finite-sample behavior.

estimand_or_formula: Within bin B: mean_i[m_hat(X_i)], where m_hat approximates E[Y | X, R=1] and is projected to the full bin population.
conditioning_or_assumption: Requires the outcome regression to transport from visible to hidden cases conditional on included features.

estimand_or_formula: Within bin B: mean_i[ m_hat(X_i) + R_i/e_i * (Y_i-m_hat(X_i)) ].
conditioning_or_assumption: Doubly robust under the usual missing-at-random/selective-label conditions when either the observation model or outcome model is correct, plus positivity and regularity; clipping changes the finite-sample target/bias-variance tradeoff.

estimand_or_formula: 1 - S_hat_KM(tau) within each fixed risk bin.
conditioning_or_assumption: Treats hospital exit as right censoring; standard KM recovery requires non-informative censoring within the analysis stratum.

estimand_or_formula: Event contribution for an observed event at time t_i: Delta_i / max(G_hat(t_i- | X_i), c); bin risk is the mean event contribution.
conditioning_or_assumption: Uses censoring survival over the risk set, not a binary horizon observability propensity. Requires conditionally independent censoring given modeled history/features and positivity of G.

estimand_or_formula: m_hat_i(tau)=1-product_t(1-h_hat_event(t | history_i)); bin risk is mean_i[m_hat_i(tau)].
conditioning_or_assumption: Requires an adequate event-hazard model over observed follow-up and transport to the full target population.
